findings.transcript_evidence: Has he had any pauses in his breathing, where he stops breathing for a few seconds? No. His sister did, though, when she had bronchiolitis two years ago. She stopped breathing in the night and we had to call an ambulance.
findings.rationale: The note records a finding (apnoea) that was explicitly denied by the relative, potentially leading to missed critical respiratory distress.
